entities.title: Bring the library tests in line with AGENTS.md
entities.summary: The seven test_*.py modules in tests/ predate the repository's test directives; only the example suites follow them.
entities.compromise: AGENTS.md section 1 lets tests that predate the directives stay as they are until they are next changed. These tests have no labelled GIVEN / WHEN / THEN sections, no "Verifies that …" docstrings, no role-prefixed names, assert several branches per test, and use shared helpers (check, status, codes, run).
entities.cost: A reader has to work out what each test proves and which branch it takes, and a failure names a test like test_dates or test_total rather than a branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Each test in tests/test_*.py follows AGENTS.md section 1: one branch per test, named for it, with sections, a docstring and role-prefixed names.
The fixture-driven tests keep running every fixture (parameterizing the same behaviour over data is allowed).

origin.description: Section 1: "Tests that predate these directives are brought in line when they are next changed."

sources.symbol: 1. Tests are written for the maintainer
